adaptation.packing: Continuous low-first U32 rows; words=(K/32)*bits. Bit5/6 extraction joins adjacent words with unsigned I64 values; only current selected K group or selected embedding rows are decoded.
adaptation.preserved: F32 affine multiply then add and dot/group order; embedding typed product then typed add; MX4/8 cast and group-scale formula unchanged.
adaptation.source_basis: Original CPU extract_bits and MLX affine dequantize equations pinned above; ATen owns bitwise/index and numeric execution.
adaptation.grouped_activation: A[T,1,K] and zero-slot-stride views collapse the shared axis before conversion; per-slot selected current-group dots reuse token rows without T*S*K activation expansion. Existing A[T,S,K] math, typed scale/bias and MX order remain unchanged.
adaptation.matrix_orientation: Affine A*W^T retains the original K-group branch. Explicit A*W keeps physical W[N,K] and K groups, decodes only selected Ntile<=64 x Kgroup tiles, then accumulates F32 products before the declared final cast. N is not required to divide a quantization group. No full NK/ENK floating bank.
